notes.NOR: 地圖的挪威含斯瓦巴群島（北緯 77–81°），那裡暖化得很快，所以比只算本土高：2024 年（2015–2024 年平均）1.8 °C，World Bank 氣候知識平台（CCKP，同樣用 CRU TS、只算本土）是 1.5 °C
notes.CAN: CRU TS 的紐芬蘭島與拉布拉多南部約 40 個格子 2018 年起突然冷了 4–6 °C，周圍的格子沒有，比較像測站資料的問題；0.5° 網格上那一帶會顯示成變冷，全國的暖化因此少了約 0.02 °C
notes.TWN: CRU TS：2016–2025 年平均比 1951–1980 年高 1.3 °C，1911–2020 年的線性趨勢約上升 1.5 °C，2025 年比 1901–2000 年平均高 1.4 °C。國家氣候變遷科學報告以中央氣象署 6 個百年測站計算，1911–2020 年上升約 1.6 °C；氣象署公布 2025 年全台平均比 1901–2000 年平均高 1.22 °C

notesEn.NOR: Norway on this map includes Svalbard (77–81° N), which is warming fast, so the figure is higher than for the mainland alone: 1.8 °C in 2024 (2015–2024 average), against 1.5 °C from the World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal (CCKP; also CRU TS, mainland only)
notesEn.CAN: In CRU TS, about 40 cells on the island of Newfoundland and in southern Labrador suddenly turn 4–6 °C colder from 2018 while surrounding cells do not, which looks like a station-data problem; that area appears to have cooled on the 0.5° grid, and national warming is about 0.02 °C lower because of it
notesEn.TWN: CRU TS: the 2016–2025 average was 1.3 °C above 1951–1980, the linear trend over 1911–2020 amounts to about 1.5 °C, and 2025 was 1.4 °C above the 1901–2000 average. Taiwan's National Climate Change Science Report, using the Central Weather Administration's six century-old stations, found a rise of about 1.6 °C over 1911–2020; the administration reported 2025 as 1.22 °C above the 1901–2000 average
